'''October 2000 Tempe tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at AZ Gamer, Arizona on 14 October 2000. [[Brett Kitani]] won it. It is known from Brian Garrison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1344">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-14-az-tournament-that-didnt-take-15-hoursd1344/ az-tournament-that-didnt-take-15-hours], DeckTech (Brian "bgkenobi" Garrison, 14 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-14-az-tournament-that-didnt-take-15-hoursd1344/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 October 2000
* '''Site:''' AZ Gamer, Arizona
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 18
* '''Winner:''' [[Brett Kitani]]
